name: USGS Cal DIG I version 2 original bathymetry and CMECS polygons
rights: CC0-1.0; cite USGS, BOEM, NOAA and MBARI as requested by original bathymetry metadata; not for navigation
limitations: The original bathymetry is a 10 m offshore grid. A source extent or 373,920 interpreted polygons is not 373,920 fishing grounds.
This source must not populate 200 ft or 300 ft bottom-fishing targets if the exact bathymetry scan finds no measured cells in those ranges.
CMECS bedrock classes are historical habitat interpretations and video-supervised, not present fish or catch observations.
Offshore use still needs MPA/federal-area geometry, date-specific regulations, depth and route checks.
